name: Chouhi Yokutoku
source:
Chouhi joins [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] along with [url=/c217]Kan'u[/url] after the two discover him together. Unlike Kan'u, who holds a more reserved master-servant-like relationship with Kazuto, she treats Kazuto like an older sibling and calls him "big brother," similar to how she treats Kan'u.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
